text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан wins the Japan Cup and, in
the midst
of thunderous applause, she
and Хиши Амадзон
vow to continue
racing each other forever.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The following day, Нарита Брайан goes to
visit Biwa
Hayahide at the hospital.
When she arrives,
however, her sister is
nowhere to be seen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ's injury has healed and
she's back
to training with all her might.
The two sisters
swear to battle at the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
